_about: Curated per-model text for the 3D models tab (04_build/src/compile_models3d.py reads it). Written 2026-10-06 from each model's METHODS_3D.md / SOURCES_3D.md (and the bathymetry REPORT.md files). 'ev' / 'quote' strings are verified against those documents at build time (whitespace and quote-style insensitive); a snippet that is not found is listed in data/models3d.json meta.verify.failed and fails check.py. Models without an entry here get auto-extracted fallbacks (provenance rows, limitations table) and a 'not yet curated' note.
ve_generic: Vertical exaggeration (VE, slider 1-5x, default 1x, always displayed in the viewer) multiplies every height (water, seabed, reef) and never a plan distance: tan(apparent angle) = VE x tan(true angle). Every number on this page is a true (1x) value. Photo-match mode forces VE = 1.
